summary: Implemented the GridPatchDataset update in monai/data/grid_dataset.py: added optional patch-level `transform`, `with_coordinates` (default True) yielding (patches, spatial start coordinates) pairs, and changed `pad_opts` to an explicit Optional[Dict] (breaking).
